notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Summer Game-Fiesta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/86e78c86c91048528e462fb4a376c7971f84a76d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/f7c3eb79e1661724e66c0254bbe68cc030f8ff1d.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow gamers![/h3]
[b]Before we all go full summer mode chilling out on the beach this is the time when we can enjoy the summertime-gaming-fiesta filled with releases, sales and new surprises straight from the Untold Tales world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/392ee1f0d8546543f4f64db832bb689e5d9ce084.png[/img]
[h3]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following gaming goodies:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the new Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Experience conveyor belt mayhem like never before, tackle the challenges of the factory floor, from operating and fixing malfunctioning machinery to navigating treacherous obstacles and prepare for the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. From the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields, there's somethin' for everyone!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/be94a1e819b9e098761440ca12ca3a7a29d59f97.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473640/EcoGnomix/

[h3]Channel your inner Gnome and get ready for EcoGnomix! [/h3]
Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes, combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna. The future of our gnomes is in your hands!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/cb333a10276e81714b48cf6c1e7fbaf5d0adfe12.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=VuIPqL-GCeU;full][/previewyoutube][h3]The sun-soaked shores of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/untoldtales/sale/untoldtales2024]Untold Tales Publisher Sale[/url] await you![/h3]
Explore diverse worlds, engage in captivating stories, and experience unforgettable gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42192/Untold_Tales_Treasures__30_for_30/
[h3]On top of that, we’ve launched the Untold Tales Treasures - a special gaming bundle filled with our titles, each designed with one ultimate goal: to deliver a unique gaming experience that will leave a lasting impression.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e6138e06f05a18fb75e4e89bfe8fbcde94ba4454.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/bff53bbb136d69eebfd0dcaf1119dc020882e85c.png[/img]
[h3]There never was a better chance to show off your balls to your friends![/h3]
Thanks to our collaboration with GimmeSwag we created the Ultimate Bang-On Balls: Chronicles plushie coming at you straight from the Roman Army. 
[b]Secure your Roman Army plushie today at [url=https://www.gimmeswag.com/products/bang-on-balls-plush?utm_source=In-Game&utm_medium=Pop+Up&utm_campaign=BoB+Roman+Army+Plush]GimmeSwag Store[/url]![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/b0d402a26a751b30d1566f5b349dec7304800e2c.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=l47gcVdtBAg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 
[i][b]Greetings all you Tesla City Martians out there! [/b][/i]

Put on your headphones just like you would a radio helmet, and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with all episodes of Radio Nostalgia Broadcast. 

[i]Dive into survivor stories blended with a harmonious tapestry of apocalypse-wave melodies.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e255a95cc853e47c1cfbdd55de631d93bcab92ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/5329ead788c53db121d72d8a24578400a336845c.png[/img]
We're almost halfway through the year and we've traveled a lot, not only virtually.
Be sure to follow our socials where we are going to share some cool spots we've already seen and give you some hints about the next stop for our Teddy on Tour.

See you on our socials 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames]Facebook[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ]Twitter[/url]  / [url=https://www.instagram.com/untoldtaleshq/]Instagram[/url] / [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtales.games]TikTok[/url] / [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChrqRdrw-oNv-AXVMOwa1yw]YouTube[/url]

[b]Your continued support means the world to us![/b][i]

notes.title: Protect the Gates of Heaven... forever! ENDLESS mode is here.
notes.content:
[h1]Guardians of Light![/h1]

Thank you for the fantastic reception of [b]Otherwar[/b], the very first commercial game by the small, yet relentless and passionate [b]Kantal Collective[/b]. We've received a lot of feedback to the launch version of the game, as well as many feature requests, encouraging comments, and fair critique. We appreciate you taking your time to give us your thoughts! That's the main way for us to pick the next steps in development and keep improving the game. But what's this? Demonic forces gather at The Gate once more! And looks like this time around, the hosts of demons are... endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/125a1081a20d66ff9fb91671951e42e56220603b.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing - ENDLESS MODE![/h2]
[list]
[*] A whole new infinite challenge
[*] Unlockable when the player who manages to beat the game on any difficulty level
[*] Three new achievements to go with it
[/list]
The Endless mode is the main feature of this first major post-release update, but it's far from being the only change. There's a lot of tweaks, fixes, and polish that comes with the new version of [b]Otherwar[/b]. Here's the...
[h2]Full CHANGELOG:[/h2]
[h3]Rebalancing and tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] first active skill is always enabled
[*] skills prices changed
[*] attack speed rebalanced
[*] damage rebalanced
[*] cheaper money towers
[/list]
[h3]Changes to towers:[/h3]
[list]
[*] attack indicator for tower laser added
[*] tower freezer - targeting fixed
[*] single upgrade price changed (base - 25, upgrade 1 - 40, upgrade 2 - 50)
[/list]
[h3]Gamepad:[/h3]
[list]
[*] now you can play with gamepad
[*] Xbox or PS controllers can be detect
[*] pause after controller disconnect
[*] crossheir is displayed automatically when playing with gamepad
[*] added auto aim - as an option to switch on/off
[/list]
[h3]Translation fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] reload time - now translated properly
[*] kill enemies - now translated properly
[*] new best time - now translated properly
[*] actual time and best time - now translated properly
[*] all german translations updated
[*] some other translation fixes
[/list]
[h3]UI tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] new preview for skills in the world map and bestiary
[*] on/off icons better placed in settings UI
[*] tooltip added at the end of the level when hoovering of the unlocked tower
[*] slot skills are animated when maneuvering over them in the world map skills panel
[/list]
[h3]Enemies tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] all bosses going to the gate after wave 10
[*] hell hounds speed changed from 1.1 -> 1.2
[*] headless bullet speed changed from 3.0 -> 3.2
[*] eye bullet speed changed from 2.5 -> 2.7
[*] boss demon - armor percentage changed from 1% -> 2%
[*] boss demon - bullet speed from 7 -> 8
[*] boss demon - teleport after every 1000HP (was after 500HP)
[*] boss demon - new shoot sound
[*] boss slime - new shoot sound
[*] boss slime minion - new shoot sound
[*] boss leshen - fixed problem with animation when teleporting
[*] level 1 - slightly easier
[/list]
[h3]Achievement fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] angel of doom - changed to 30k killed enemies
[*] achievements true fighter, savings, faster than evil - now works correctly
[*] new achievement added - endless mode - dark forest
[*] new achievement added - endless mode - swamp
[*] new achievement added - endless mode - hell
[/list]
[h3]Suond added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] skill holy wave sound added
[*] skill freezer sound added
[*] skill holy shield sound added
[/list]
[h3]Other assorted polish and tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] more credits added
[*] level 7 little wider - little harder
[*] blessing attack speed limited to 3 usages
[*] blessing golden gift added to the pool
[*] loader in-between levels - for the low end PC's
[*] level failed panel above tutorial canvas
[*] new preview for towers in the world map and bestiary - more info
[/list]

That's it for today. 
[h2]May your will be strong with the Light![/h2]
[h3]Kantal Collective & Hyperstrange[/h3]

notes.title: Update 13 - 66 days before the release, demo 2.0 and price of the game
notes.content:
[h1]Quick note[/h1]
We are 66 before the release day of Otherwar.  We have some more thing to do, but our excitement is huge, as we want to hit that release button and watch you playing the game.

The game is 10x bigger than the previous one, and the project was initially supposed to be completed in six months. Since the start in 2020, a lot of things have changed, from graphics to music and the main features of the game. Here are some screenshots to remind you of how it has changed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/fc7d0fd92880bc12e628eb88ec355168c3455676.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/34dc2f8984c65d58544b3d9730d228fbb00be1b6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/9e8e16df13245163ac184b1e702cb7ae5dc541ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/6c3c74ba19c9b1c89bfa64ddd95c46938e836c1c.png[/img]

[h1]Zawartość gry[/h1]
Otherwar is an action tower defense with an active hero, unlockable skills and a huge content (as project after hours).
- 9 levels
- 9 towers
- 19 enemies 
- 3 bosses
- 12 skills
- 24 achievements
- 4 languages

[h1]Price of the game and optional dlcs[/h1]
Price of the game at release will be 5$ (with -15% discount), and optional DLC:
- Buy me a coffee - 1.99$ -mini art book, unused art
- Buy me a pizza - 9.99$ - mini art book, unused art game, creation progress
- Buy me a dinner - 19.99$ - mini art book, unused art game creation progress, early demos
*DLC's doesn't affect the main game content

[h1]Demo 2.0[/h1]
On September 1, we plan to release demo 2.0, enhanced with the features you asked for, including crosshair and support for resolutions greater than Full HD.

[h1]Concept art[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463314/76a10b0f1821f4257927a0b9c234cd6ac58a0958.png[/img]

tags.feature: On September 1, we plan to release demo 2.0, enhanced with the features you asked for, including crosshair and support for resolutions greater than Full HD.

notes.title: Demo - Small patch 2
notes.content:
This is the list of changes in the demo:
- added keybinding in the settings menu
- health bars of skeletons fixed
- attack animations of towers are now time independent
- character movement stopped after killing all monsters to prevent bugs
- overall rebuilding of Enemy Bullets and their animations
- enemy bullets now are bigger 
- added some loading screens

Good luck in the game.

notes.title: Update 5 - Boss Ent
notes.content:
[h1]Quick note[/h1]
Hello again. This month it's time for the boss from the first chapter. In the Black Forest you will meet an Ent who will move and shoot. Of course, he is supported by normal waves of enemies, so you'll have to think about a balanced combat strategy.

notes.title: Update 2 - Skills
notes.content:
[h1]Quick note[/h1]
To ensure the gameplay variety, we have introduced a skill tree to the game.
By defeating enemies, you will gain coins that will allow you to unlock, among others, a double shot or stronger hero attacks. Some skills will be available almost immediately, others require a little more effort.

More kills = more upgrades = more fun
